clos.loDetails: Help students to understand and solve the practical problems in selecting careers and objectives in the future.
Open new opportunities for students to apply knowledge and skills in practical working situations in an effective way.
Identify necessary knowledge and skills to become a real worker in trade or forwarder/shipping company in the future.
Build strengthening cooperation between Faculty / Industry / Curriculum with Professional Associations and businesses to standardize and develop vocational skills as well as education.
Promote participation of businesses in the assessment of occupational skills and ethics to innovate, and improve the quality of vocational education associated with the needs of businesses.
